product.title: Edinburgh Walking Food Tour With Secret Food Tours

description.text: Edinburgh's Old Town and New Town food streets are easier with a local on this three-hour Secret Food Tours walk. The small group samples haggis, neeps and tatties, Scotch whisky, afternoon tea, cakes, fudge, and a secret dish while covering the Royal Mile and Edinburgh Old Town. Stops include Royal Mile, Edinburgh Old Town. Groups stay at ten or fewer, meeting near St. Giles' Cathedral. The walking format stays on neighborhood kitchens rather than landmark ticket lines. Ideal for visitors basing in Edinburgh who want a guided tasting walk instead of guessing which Old Town menus are worth the queue.

highlights: Enjoy classic Scottish food such as authentic Haggis, award winning Lowland Single Malt Whisky
Learn why Edinburgh locals are so passionate about their food
Explore the local streets on a walking food tour
Small-group experience with no more than 10 participants
